subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw ship a current-session reset capability on `PluginHookAgentContext` for `after_compaction`, and must it support the unshipped explicit-key compatibility form?
rationale: This creates a public plugin contract with authority to archive and replace session state; repository policy requires owner intent for the permanent signature and for any broader automatic recovery behavior.

options.title: Approve the narrow API
options.body: Expose only `resetSession(reason?)` on successful, lifecycle-owned after-compaction contexts and remove the explicit-key overload plus unrelated tool-loop policies.

options.title: Adopt compatibility explicitly
options.body: Keep a required two-argument current-key overload, document it as a supported contract, and add complete compatibility and live lifecycle proof.

options.title: Pause the core API
options.body: Do not ship the capability until an owner-led session/plugin API design establishes the permanent authority and lifecycle boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API
recommendation.body: Expose only `resetSession(reason?)` on successful, lifecycle-owned after-compaction contexts and remove the explicit-key overload plus unrelated tool-loop policies.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-based owner for Codex and embedded-run terminal lifecycle behavior spanning this PR.
